After No IP - 3rd Party Polycom

fields.name: End_Content
fields.fieldText:
Firmware Upgrade Successful


Inform the customer that the phone's firmware has now been updated. Make sure to let the customer know if there were any changes done on their phone and/or account and why.


Close/disconnect the shared screen if RingCentral Meetings was used.



You have now completed this guide. Click "Next" to update the case you are working on.

Refer To Vendor



Since it has been determined that the problem has something to do with the device itself, click on "Next" to proceed on creating/updating the case you are working on.

fields.name: End_Content_04
